title: Your First Weekend at Cornell University, Shared as Cards
description: A curated sequence of essential Cornell experiences for new students, from sunset views on Libe Slope to the iconic flavors of the Dairy Bar.

cards.title: Kick Off Your Cornell Journey
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide
cards.notes: Begin your first weekend with New Student Orientation (NSO) events. Meet your Orientation Leader and small group to navigate campus resources and build early connections.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome program for all incoming first-year and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Orientation (NSO) for 2026 is scheduled for August 18–23, featuring required small group meetings and social activities.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; schedules are provided via the Cornell orientation portal.

cards.title: Watch the Sunset on the Slope
cards.subtitle: Between Uris Library and West Campus
cards.notes: Join fellow students on the grassy hill for a quintessential Ithaca sunset. Bring a blanket and enjoy the panoramic views of West Campus and the city below.
cards.short_summary: A beloved campus tradition where students gather nightly to watch the sun set over the valley.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunsets on Libe Slope are a long-standing campus tradition, especially popular when students first arrive in August.
cards.source_title: Uniquely Cornell: Four Activities to do in Four Seasons
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; best visited during the hour before sunset.

cards.title: Taste Official Cornell Ice Cream
cards.subtitle: Stocking Hall
cards.notes: Visit the east end of campus for a scoop of premium ice cream made on-site. Try signature flavors like 'Bavarian Raspberry Fudge' or 'Big Red Bear Tracks.'
cards.short_summary: The university's famous dairy shop serving ice cream, milk, and yogurt produced by the Department of Food Science.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Dairy Bar is located in Stocking Hall and serves ice cream, sundaes, and floats made from Cornell Dairy products.
cards.access_notes: Check seasonal hours; typically open weekdays 8:30 AM - 6:00 PM during the fall semester.

cards.title: Listen to the McGraw Tower Chimes
cards.subtitle: Ho Plaza
cards.notes: Pause at the center of campus to hear the 21-bell chime. Concerts often include a mix of the Alma Mater, classical pieces, and modern pop requests.
cards.short_summary: Daily musical performances played by student Chimesmasters from the top of McGraw Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Chimes are performed from McGraw Tower three times a day during the school year.
cards.access_notes: Concerts are audible from the Arts Quad and Ho Plaza; tower climbs may be restricted during orientation.

cards.title: Walk the Beebe Lake Loop
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Take a relaxing one-mile walk around the lake. It's a perfect escape into nature located just steps away from the first-year residence halls on North Campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic natural area featuring a wooded trail, wetlands, and views of Fall Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beebe Lake Natural Area features a one-mile loop trail popular for hiking and jogging.
cards.source_title: Beebe Lake and Woods | Cornell Botanic Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; trails are mostly flat and easy to navigate.

cards.title: Grab Breakfast at CTB
cards.subtitle: 420 College Avenue
cards.notes: Experience a Cornell rite of passage by ordering a bagel sandwich at 'CTB.' It's the social hub of Collegetown and a favorite weekend morning destination.
cards.short_summary: An iconic local eatery and community space that has served Cornellians since 1976.
cards.evidence_claim: Collegetown Bagels (CTB) is described as a shared experience for nearly all Cornellians and a staple of student life.
cards.source_title: Inside Collegetown Bagels' Role in the Tapestry of Cornell's Culture
cards.access_notes: Open daily; expect long lines on weekend mornings during the first few weeks of school.

cards.entity_name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.title: Explore the Johnson Museum
cards.subtitle: Central Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the museum to see world-class art and head to the top floor for one of the best indoor views of campus and Cayuga Lake.
cards.short_summary: Cornell's primary art museum, known for its diverse collections and distinctive I.M. Pei-designed building.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Johnson Museum of Art is always free for everyone, and it features a rooftop with views of Central Campus.
cards.source_title: Visit - Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 10 AM – 5 PM; closed on Mondays.

cards.title: Relax in the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Ho Plaza
cards.notes: Known as the campus 'living room,' the Straight offers cozy lounges and a browsing library. It's a great spot to meet friends or find a quiet corner to read.
cards.short_summary: Cornell's historic student union building, home to student activities, dining, and a cinema.
cards.evidence_claim: Willard Straight Hall is considered the 'living room' of the campus, with lounges like the Browsing Library open to the public.
cards.source_title: Willard Straight Hall Student Union - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Building hours are typically 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM daily during the semester.

cards.title: Visit the Tatkon Center Hub
cards.subtitle: Robert Purcell Community Center
cards.notes: Stop by the 'Tat' on North Campus to meet Peer Leaders who can answer questions about your first week and help you find your way around.
cards.short_summary: A resource center specifically designed to support new students during their transition to Cornell.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tatkon Center Hub is located on the first floor of the Robert Purcell Community Center (RPCC) and is staffed by Tatkon Peer Leaders.
cards.source_title: Tatkon Center for New Students | Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Located in RPCC 101; typically open Sunday–Thursday for student support.

cards.title: Get Your Big Red Gear
cards.subtitle: Ho Plaza
cards.notes: Pick up your first Cornell t-shirt or hoodie. It's the central spot for textbooks, supplies, and all things Big Red to prepare for the start of classes.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore and merchandise center located in the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Store is the primary location for university merchandise and academic supplies, located on Ho Plaza.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check website for extended orientation weekend hours.
